newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts 3Com Q3 outlook.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts 3Com Q3 outlook.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analysts Peter Swartz said he cut his estimates for earnings and revenues on 3Com Corp in its fiscal third quarter ending in February and reiterated his hold rating on the networking stock.
-- He said he cut his fiscal third quarter revenue estimate to $845 million from $880 million and his earnings estimate to $0.61 per share from $0.63.

-- The analyst said he based his more conservative estimates on talks with 3Com officials at a meeting with analysts in New York Tuesday. He said officials had discussed a December sales slowdown followed by a pickup in January.
-- "My sense right now is that they are below plan by $60 to $70 million," he said. "It is clearly going to come down to February" (for it to meet Wall Street's expectations), he said.
-- Swartz noted that the stock is seemingly cheap at its current level but that, "I don't want to get in front of one of these networking stocks when fundamentals seem to be deterioriating."
